1. PLAY > Map: pick a map and scenario, day or night. The right column (Your match) always shows the whole setup; click a line to change it.
2. PLAY > Squad: presets and the values for your teammates, the enemies and the AI difficulty. A squad preset only changes the bot values.

3. PLAY > Rules: every other match setting of that mode (changed values turn gold), with presets: Styles, the Official rulesets and the official Playlists. A preset takes the previous one's rules and mutators back out before it puts in its own; what you changed by hand stays.
4. PLAY > Mods: tick the mutators you want, in load order. Installed mods lists the mods on your PC. PLAY > Advanced shows exactly what will be sent to the game.
5. The Setup bar at the top keeps your match: Save keeps everything (map, scenario, bots, rules, mutators, Advanced) as a saved setup, and picking a saved setup loads it back.

6. Press the big button (or F5). "Start and launch" writes your rules to Game.ini, starts the game if needed, waits for the main menu and loads the match through the game's own remote console (RCON, on this PC only); no keys are pressed. The arrow next to it switches to "Start the server": the same match on your dedicated server (set it up on the Server page).
7. LIVE works during a match: restart rounds, change rules, cheat buttons (clock, bots, god mode) and any console command, all over RCON.
